title: Add manhwa studio to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [manhwa studio](https://manhwa-studio-320488177521.asia-southeast1.run.app) to image
- Create webtoon comics with character profiles, scene planning, Pollinations-generated panels, dialogue bubbles and a vertical comic canvas.

Fixes #14371

gist.headline: Panels in the pollen
gist.blurb: A new manhwa studio has sprouted in the garden. Plan scenes, keep character profiles straight, and let Pollinations help fill a tall scroll of comic panels and dialogue.
gist.summary: Added Manhwa Studio to the image apps directory, providing a webtoon-comic workspace with character profiles, scene planning, Pollinations-generated panels, dialogue bubbles, and a vertical comic canvas.
gist.impact: Creators can now discover and use Manhwa Studio to turn planned scenes into vertically scrolling webtoon pages with generated art and dialogue in one place.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Manhwa Studio as a cozy vertical webtoon workspace: a tall scrolling comic canvas with several pastel generated panels, character-profile cards, scene-planning notes, and dialogue bubbles. Polli, wearing a tiny manga artist beret and holding a pixel pen, helps arrange the panels while code-flowers and vines grow around the desk; the scene represents an app added to the community image-tools garden.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light-blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny manga artist beret and arranging a tall vertical webtoon canvas of pastel comic panels, character-profile cards, scene notes, and speech bubbles beside blooming code-plants; a retro monitor glows prominently lime green (#ecf874), with simple pixel text: "MANHWA STUDIO". Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with dark purple (#110518) outlines and a warm cream garden-studio background, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
